records.name: FTII Pune
records.description: Film and Television Institute of India, Pune is a government autonomous institute offering diploma programs in film direction, cinematography, editing, sound, and acting.

records.name: SRFTI Kolkata
records.description: Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute, Kolkata is a national institute of film education offering diploma programs in direction, cinematography, sound recording, editing, and production design.

records.name: Whistling Woods International Mumbai
records.description: Whistling Woods International, Mumbai is one of Asia's leading film, communication, and media arts schools, offering undergraduate and postgraduate programs in filmmaking, media management, and acting.

records.name: IIM (MBA Marketing)
records.description: The Indian Institutes of Management offer some of Asia's most competitive MBA programs with a marketing specialization, combining case-based learning with strong alumni networks and industry exposure.

records.name: MICA Ahmedabad
records.description: Mudra Institute of Communications, Ahmedabad is India's premier communications and marketing management school, offering the two-year PGDM-Communications program with deep industry integration.

records.name: XLRI Jamshedpur
records.description: Xavier Labour Relations Institute, Jamshedpur is one of India's oldest and most respected business schools, known for its Human Resources Management and Business Management programs.

records.name: SP Jain Mumbai
records.description: S.P. Jain Institute of Management and Research, Mumbai is a leading private business school known for innovative MBA and PGDM programs with strong industry partnerships and global exposure.

records.name: RIEs (Regional Institutes of Education)
records.description: Regional Institutes of Education are central government institutions under NCERT that offer integrated undergraduate and postgraduate teacher education programs across different regions of India.

records.name: DIET
records.description: District Institutes of Education and Training are government institutions at the district level that provide in-service training and professional development programs for school teachers.

records.name: State CTEs
records.description: State Colleges of Teacher Education offer government-funded B.Ed and M.Ed programs preparing candidates for secondary and higher secondary school teaching across various Indian states.
